name: shader-metaballs
title: Metaballs
description: Soft blobs drift, merge and split like a lava lamp, each tinted from your palette, drawn in WebGL.
useWhen: A playful or organic scene wants lava-lamp blobs merging and splitting.
You want soft, rounded motion that reads as fun without being childish.
You want blob count and size tunable via `count` and `size`.
avoidWhen: The brand is strictly serious or corporate: metaballs read playful.
You want structured or geometric motion: use shader-dot-orbit or shader-voronoi.
Blobs would obscure dense foreground content: lower `count` and `size`.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Up to 8 colors, comma separated, for the blobs.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the shader in or out.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it when fine detail looks soft.
